stem: Diya reads a cricket scoreboard that shows overs as $17.2$.

options.text: $17.2$ overs means $17$ overs and $2$ balls in the next over.
$17.2$ overs means $17$ overs plus two-tenths of an over.
$17.2$ is a decimal because a point is printed between $17$ and $2$.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: In overs notation the point separates completed overs from balls (out of 6), so it is not ordinary decimal place value.

teacher.key_rationale: Cricket overs use a context separator: 17.2 means 17 overs and 2 balls, not 17.2 in decimal tenths. Reading tenths omits the overs unit context. The printed point alone is a surface feature.
